hits.title: Neumora Therapeutics Appoints Joshua Pinto as CEO and Releases Q2 2026 Financial Results
hits.snippet: CEO Change Effective August 14, 2026: Joshua Pinto, Ph.D., previously the company’s President, took over as Chief Executive Officer from Paul L. Berns on this date. Executive Chairperson Appointment: Paul L. Berns transitioned to Executive Chairperson of the Board of Directors following the CEO change. Dual Leadership Role: Dr. Pinto will maintain his position as President in addition to serving as CEO. Board Membership: The Board appointed Dr. Pinto as a Class III director effective August 14, 2026, with a term lasting until the 2029 Annual Meeting of Stockholders. Board Approval Date: Both the leadership transition and Dr. Pinto’s board appointment were approved on August 12, 2026.
